constraints.bodySilhouette: very long, narrow, flat, ground-skimming trunk; belly near ground without intersection
constraints.head: thin pointed wedge: reduced cranium, cheek, eyelid and snout width as one anatomy
constraints.eyes: two narrow luminous amber predator eyes, slit pupils
constraints.horns: exactly two large backward-swept horns with visibly arched quadratic centerline
constraints.legs: four shoulder/hip muscles buried inside ribcage, strongly lateral upper arms/thighs, 90-degree knees, short vertically dropping lower arms/shins, four small planted paws; no gaps
constraints.tail: long attached whip tail, seamless joins and curled tip, fully visible in full-body camera on portrait phones
constraints.spines: small low-profile backward jagged basalt spines
constraints.surface: black obsidian plates and narrow molten orange seams
